metadata.title: $L^p$-Liouville properties and realizations of Schrödinger operators on incomplete Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: The aim of the paper is to highlight and standardize in a self-contained framework the connections between some properties associated with the Laplace-Beltrami operator on possibly incomplete Riemannian manifolds. We present both new and well-known characterizations of the positivity-preserving property, essential self-adjointness, and Liouville-type results for $L^2$-functions, using the latter to establish a clear hierarchy among these properties. Furthermore, we prove the stability of the essential self-adjointness of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on incomplete Riemannian manifolds under the removal of closed (possibly non-compact) subsets from a complete manifold, subject to suitable conditions on their (generalized) Hausdorff measure. With appropriate modifications, this framework is adapted throughout the paper to the general $L^p$-case for $p\in (1,+\infty)$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 整理不完备黎曼流形上 Schrödinger 算子的正性保持、本质自伴与 Lp-Liouville 性质，并研究移去闭集后的稳定性。
techniques: 算子实现与本质自伴性
analysis.breakthrough: 在广义 Hausdorff 测度条件下允许移去可能非紧的闭集，并将部分框架推广到 1<p<∞。
analysis.limitations: 文中同时包含已知结论的统一证明和新结果；各性质的蕴含方向及集合条件需分别使用。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI Statement 披露用 AI 审阅笔误、次要错误和不一致，并建议简化 Proposition 4.27、Lemma 5.13 的证明；作者审核最终内容。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29514v1 · PDF 第 41 页 AI Statement

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。AI Statement 披露用 AI 审阅笔误、次要错误和不一致，并建议简化 Proposition 4.27、Lemma 5.13 的证明；作者审核最终内容。

analysis.priorityReason: 将分析性质与奇异集几何相联系，适合关注算子可去性的读者。
